v.1: When the sky is rent apart,
v.5: then a soul shall know what it has sent ahead and left behind.
v.6: O man! What has deceived you about your generous Lord,
v.7: who created you and proportioned you, and gave you an upright nature,
v.8: and composed you in any form that He wished?
v.9: No! Indeed, you deny the Retribution.
v.10: Indeed, there are over you watchers,
v.13: Indeed the pious shall be amid bliss,
v.14: and indeed the vicious shall be in hell,
v.15: entering it on the Day of Retribution,
v.16: and they shall not be absent from it.
v.17: And what will show you what is the Day of Retribution?
v.18: Again, what will show you what is the Day of Retribution?
v.19: It is a day when no soul will be of any avail to another soul and all command that day will belong to Allah.
